question: 2026年9月已送达订单数是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM business.orders x JOIN business.customers c ON x.customer_id=c.id WHERE x.status='paid' AND x.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01' AND x.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business.shipping_events t WHERE t.order_id=x.id AND t.status='delivered')

question: 2026年9月排除华东的已送达订单数是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM business.orders x JOIN business.customers c ON x.customer_id=c.id WHERE x.status='paid' AND x.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01' AND x.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business.shipping_events t WHERE t.order_id=x.id AND t.status='delivered') AND c.region <> '华东'

question: 2026-09-26至2026-09-27已支付订单数是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM business.orders WHERE status='paid' AND ordered_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-26' AND ordered_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-27'

question: 2026-09-26至2026-09-27退款率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business.refunds f WHERE f.order_id=o.id AND f.status='succeeded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric)/nullif(count(*),0) AS value FROM business.orders o WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-26' AND o.ordered_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-27'

question: 2026-09-26至2026-09-27客单价是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT sum((SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM business.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id))/nullif(count(*),0) AS value FROM business.orders o WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-26' AND o.ordered_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-27'
